description: An example problem pair presents a fully worked solution followed immediately by a similar problem for the learner to solve, alternating study of an example with practice on an isomorphic task.
title: Example Problem Pairs

description: An exemplar is a high-quality model of a finished product or performance — an essay, design, proof, or solution — that learners study to internalize quality criteria before producing their own work.
title: Exemplars

description: Short bouts of physical activity inserted into instruction to restore attention, support memory consolidation, and improve on-task behavior.
title: Exercise Breaks

description: The study built a two-tier annotation scheme in EXMARaLDA Partitur Editor to code negotiation work and negative feedback across text and video data.
title: EXMARaLDA-based annotation scheme for negotiation of meaning and negative feedback in CMC data

description: The program's stated technology requirements include \"Internet access with an updated web browser to access a web-based Salesforce database system\".
title: Salesforce-based web database and online survey infrastructure for program management

description: Learners form predictions, manipulate variables, and test hypotheses against observed outcomes rather than receiving conclusions directly.
title: Experimentation

description: Learners become subject-matter experts on one segment of a topic and teach that segment to peers, distributing expertise across the group.
title: Expert Groups

description: Expert modeling is the element in which a skilled performer demonstrates not only what to do, but how an expert notices cues, makes decisions, and checks quality during performance.
title: Expert Modeling

description: Explicit teaching is the element in which instructors directly explain, model, and sequence key knowledge or procedures rather than leaving them to be inferred.
title: Explicit Teaching

description: A study commissioned by the Institute of Education Sciences that \"collected extensive information about instructional practices in prekindergarten through grade 3 within Title I schools and examined the relationships...
title: Exploratory study of instructional practices in prekindergarten through grade 3 in Title I schools

description: The guide includes an extensive compilation of resource materials supporting both students and teachers.
title: 33-page annotated resource listing for students and teachers
